name: Pilate Pontius
overview: Pilate Pontius served as the Roman governor of Judaea during Jesus' ministry, playing a pivotal role in the trial and crucifixion of Christ. Scripture records that Jesus was delivered to Pilate, who ultimately ordered His crucifixion, yet also granted Joseph of Arimathaea permission to take Jesus' body for burial. Additionally, Pilate's governance included harsh actions such as causing the slaughter of certain Galileans, reflecting the turbulent political environment of the time.
